name: AI Cinema Breakout Video: The Train Comes Out of the Screen
blurb: An AI cinema breakout video is a shaky phone clip from the front row of a cinema where the film breaks out of the screen.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=ai-cinema-breakout-video) and add your photo (your photo). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the subject's face, facial features, skin tone, and hair exactly the same. Place the subject in a red velvet seat in the front row of a dark, packed cinema, filmed from the side by a friend's phone. The subject looks up at a giant glowing screen that shows an old steam train racing toward the camera. Other audience members sit around them, dimly lit. Realistic phone photo, low light grain. Vertical 9:16. No text, no logos, no movie titles.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 8 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: One continuous handheld phone shot from the front row of a dark cinema, no cuts, no change of angle. Keep the main person's face, hair and outfit exactly as in the image. On the giant screen, the steam train rushes toward the audience, then its huge black front physically bursts out through the screen into the cinema in a blast of smoke and wind, and stops just above the front row. Popcorn flies and hair blows back. The person screams and grabs the seat, then bursts out laughing with the people around them. Audio: a loud train horn, rushing wind, a crowd screaming, then laughter. No text, no logos, no real movie characters.
